candidates.change_summary: Change the equality check of msg.value from == 10 ether to != 10 ether so fallback accepts any call except exactly 10 ether.
Change the time comparison from > to < so fallback requires block.timestamp to be earlier than pastBlockTime.
Assign pastBlockTime to block.number instead of block.timestamp, changing stored state to block number.
Change modulus divisor from 15 to 16 so transfers occur on different block numbers.
Remove the conditional transfer so fallback never forwards the contract balance to sender.
Insert an unconditional transfer to sender after updating pastBlockTime so every qualifying call drains the contract.
Move the assignment to pastBlockTime after the conditional transfer so the transfer uses the old pastBlockTime check outcome.
